keywords.name: <Active Pokemon>
text: The Pokemon in your Active Spot. Only the Active Pokemon can attack. You must always have exactly 1 Active Pokemon.

keywords.name: <Asleep>
text: Special Condition. Turn the Pokemon counterclockwise. It cannot attack or retreat. During Pokemon Checkup, flip a coin — heads recovers, tails stays Asleep.

keywords.name: <Bench>
text: Row for Benched Pokemon (up to 5). They can use Abilities but cannot attack. Damage to Benched Pokemon ignores Weakness and Resistance.

keywords.name: <Burned>
text: Special Condition. Place a Burn marker. During Pokemon Checkup, place 2 damage counters, then flip a coin — heads recovers. Only one Burn marker at a time.

keywords.name: <Confused>
text: Special Condition. Turn the card top toward you. Before attacking, flip a coin — heads means normal attack; tails means attack fails and you place 3 damage counters on your Pokemon.

keywords.name: <Damage Counters>
text: Each counter equals 10 damage. A Pokemon is KO'd when total counters equal or exceed HP/10.

keywords.name: <Energy>
text: Cards that power attacks. 11 types: Grass, Fire, Water, Lightning, Psychic, Fighting, Darkness, Metal, Fairy, Dragon, Colorless. Attach 1 per turn from hand to a Pokemon.

keywords.name: <Evolution>
text: Playing a Stage 1 or 2 card on top of a qualifying Pokemon. Keeps attached cards and damage counters, loses Special Conditions and effects. Cannot evolve on first turn or the turn a Pokemon was played.

keywords.name: <Knocked Out>
text: When total damage equals or exceeds HP. The Pokemon and attached cards go to discard. Opponent takes Prize card(s): 1 normally, 2 for ex/V/GX, 3 for VMAX/TAG TEAM/Mega ex.

keywords.name: <Mulligan>
text: If no Basic Pokemon in opening hand: reveal, shuffle back, draw 7 new cards. Repeat until you have one. Opponent may draw 1 extra card per mulligan you take beyond shared ones.

keywords.name: <Paralyzed>
text: Special Condition. Turn the Pokemon clockwise. It cannot attack or retreat. Recovers automatically during Pokemon Checkup after its owner's next turn.

keywords.name: <Poisoned>
text: Special Condition. Place a Poison marker. During Pokemon Checkup, place 1 damage counter. Only one Poison marker at a time.

keywords.name: <Prize Cards>
text: 6 face-down cards set aside during setup. Take 1 when you KO an opponent's Pokemon. Taking your last Prize card wins the game.

keywords.name: <Resistance>
text: Reduced damage from certain types (e.g. -20). Printed lower-left. Apply after Weakness. Only affects defending Active Pokemon.

keywords.name: <Retreat>
text: Switch Active Pokemon with a Benched one. Discard Energy equal to Retreat Cost. Once per turn. Clears Special Conditions. Asleep/Paralyzed Pokemon cannot retreat.

keywords.name: <Weakness>
text: Extra damage from certain types (e.g. x2). Printed lower-left. Apply before Resistance. Only affects defending Active Pokemon.

keywords.name: <Pokemon ex>
text: Powerful Pokemon with strong attacks and higher HP. When Knocked Out, opponent takes 2 Prize cards. 'ex' is part of the Pokemon's name.

keywords.name: <Pokemon V>
text: Powerful Basic Pokemon with high HP and strong attacks. When Knocked Out, opponent takes 2 Prize cards. Pokemon VSTAR and VMAX evolve from Pokemon V.

keywords.name: <Pokemon VSTAR>
text: Evolves from Pokemon V. Has a VSTAR Power (attack or Ability) that can only be used once per game. When Knocked Out, opponent takes 2 Prize cards. Considered a Pokemon V.

keywords.name: <Pokemon VMAX>
text: Evolves from Pokemon V. Massive HP (300+) and strong attacks. When Knocked Out, opponent takes 3 Prize cards. Considered a Pokemon V.

keywords.name: <Pokemon V-UNION>
text: Made of 4 separate cards with the same name. All 4 pieces must be played from discard pile to Bench at the same time. Takes 1 Bench spot. When KO'd, opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

keywords.name: <Pokemon-GX>
text: Powerful Pokemon with a special GX attack usable once per game. When Knocked Out, opponent takes 2 Prize cards. 'GX' is part of the Pokemon's name.

keywords.name: <Pokemon-EX>
text: Older powerful Pokemon type. When Knocked Out, opponent takes 2 Prize cards. 'EX' is part of the Pokemon's name. Different from Pokemon ex.

keywords.name: <Mega Evolution Pokemon ex>
text: Supremely powerful Pokemon ex. When Knocked Out, opponent takes 3 Prize cards. Can appear as Basic, Stage 1, or Stage 2 Pokemon.

keywords.name: <Mega Evolution Pokemon-EX>
text: Evolves from Pokemon-EX. When you play one, your turn ends immediately. When Knocked Out, opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

keywords.name: <TAG TEAM>
text: Special Basic Pokemon-GX featuring multiple Pokemon. Very high HP with bonus GX attacks. When Knocked Out, opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

keywords.name: <Radiant Pokemon>
text: Shiny Basic Pokemon. Only 1 Radiant Pokemon allowed per deck. Always Basic, never evolves.

keywords.name: <Tera Pokemon ex>
text: Pokemon ex with a crystalline effect that prevents all attack damage while on your Bench. When KO'd, opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

keywords.name: <Dual-Type Pokemon>
text: A Pokemon with two types simultaneously. Affected by effects targeting either type. Weakness and Resistance apply for both types.

keywords.name: <BREAK Evolution>
text: Special evolution that keeps the previous Pokemon's attacks and Abilities, then adds more. Changes HP and possibly type. 'BREAK' is part of the name.

keywords.name: <Restored Pokemon>
text: Fossil Pokemon that can only be played via an Item card effect. Not a Basic Pokemon. Cannot be played from hand normally.

keywords.name: <Ancient Trait>
text: Special powers on certain Pokemon cards, printed under the name. Not attacks or Abilities — cards that block those won't affect Ancient Traits.

keywords.name: <ACE SPEC>
text: Extremely powerful Trainer cards. Only 1 total ACE SPEC card allowed per deck (not 1 of each — 1 total).

keywords.name: <Prism Star>
text: Powerful cards limited to 1 copy per name per deck. Sent to Lost Zone instead of discard pile.

keywords.name: <Lost Zone>
text: Cards sent here are permanently removed from the game — they cannot be recovered like the discard pile.

keywords.name: <Special Conditions>
text: Asleep, Burned, Confused, Paralyzed, and Poisoned. Only affect Active Pokemon. Cleared when a Pokemon evolves or moves to the Bench.
Asleep, Confused, and Paralyzed rotate the card; Burned and Poisoned use markers. A Pokemon can have multiple Special Conditions at once (e.g. Burned + Paralyzed + Poisoned).

keywords.name: <Trainer Cards>
text: Special cards with four subtypes: Item (unlimited per turn), Supporter (1 per turn), Stadium (1 per turn, stays in play), and Pokemon Tool (attach to a Pokemon, 1 per Pokemon).

keywords.name: <Abilities>
text: Special effects on Pokemon that are not attacks. Some are always active, others you choose to use. Usable from both Active and Benched Pokemon. Does not end your turn.
